findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sample, check_book, get_free_key · Public sink: get_sample, check_book, check_invoice, check_quote_math, check_budget_variance, check_accounts_tieout, check_data_quality, get_free_key · Destructive: get_sample, check_invoice, check_quote_math, check_budget_variance, check_accounts_tieout, check_data_quality.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sample, check_book, get_free_key · Public sink: get_sample, check_book, check_invoice, check_quote_math, check_budget_variance, check_accounts_tieout, check_data_quality, get_free_key · Destructive: get_sample, check_invoice, check_quote_math, check_budget_variance, check_accounts_tieout, check_data_quality

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
